spec_features.spec_quote: Unparseable judge output yields a `null` rating that is **kept in the JSONL and excluded from metrics** (and reported), so failures are visible
spec_features.evidence: parse failure -> JudgeResult(rating=None, ..., raw=raw) in judge.py:71-76 and judge.py:155 (retries exhausted). Generation error -> ResponseRecord(rating=None, judge_raw='<generation-error: ...>') in rollout.py:75-89, appended to records. All records (incl. null) written via r.to_dict() in run_eval.py:145-147. analyze.py _scored() (line 64-65) filters out rating-None rows from metrics; null_count computed at analyze.py:254 and reported in markdown summary (analyze.py:129-130: '{null_count} null-rating rows excluded') and console (analyze.py:271-272). End-to-end: kept in JSONL, excluded from metrics, reported.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced. Null rows are both kept (judge_raw preserves raw text/error) and excluded from per_category_stats/per_turn_stats, and the count is surfaced separately.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we record the raw text and a null score so the row can be inspected rather than silently dropped
